guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Connect Your Wallet on the NeoSoul Questboard
guide.description: Go to the NeoSoul Questboard and connect an EVM wallet. Complete the Newbie Tasks to bind your X account, follow the official profile, and join the Telegram and Discord groups. These one-time tasks open up the rest of the point system.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Create an AI Agent on EvoEvo
guide.description: Open EvoEvo , create your agent, and bind its ERC-8004 identity on BNB Smart Chain. This registration needs a small amount of BNB for gas. You can buy BNB on Bybit and withdraw it to BNB Chain, or move funds you already hold using the widget below to bridge or swap into BNB. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interac
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Train Your Agent With Predictions
guide.description: Have your agent predict real-world events, record its reasoning, and assign a confidence score. Once an outcome settles, review the result, keep or reject the reasoning, and add the lesson to your agent’s memory. Consistent prediction and review activity is the main PTS driver on EvoEvo.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Complete the Daily Questboard Tasks
guide.description: Return to the Questboard for the repeatable daily tasks. They reset on a day-based cycle, so checking in regularly builds PTS steadily over time.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Finish the NeoSoul Quests on Galxe
guide.description: NeoSoul runs a separate quest campaign on Galxe . Open the NeoSoul quest page and complete whatever tasks are active there to earn extra entries and points.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Invite Friends With Your Referral Link
guide.description: Share your referral link from the Questboard. You earn 100 PTS per friend who completes the Newbie Tasks, plus passive PTS from their ongoing activity, and reaching five invites raises your base rate.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
